how_to_apply: Download the vacancy notice and Curriculum Vitae Proforma (Annexure-A) from http://www.gmch.gov.in.
Fill the CV Proforma, affix a duly attested photograph and sign it.
Get the application forwarded through your department (proper channel), countersigned by the employer with seal.
The forwarding department must enclose ACR/APAR, integrity, vigilance, no court case and penalty certificates.
Application must reach O/o the Director, Medical Education & Research, GMCH, Block 'D', Level-II, Sector-32, Chandigarh-160030 by 18.12.2026.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Officers under the Central Government/State Governments/Union Territories/Recognized Universities/Recognized Research Institutions/Public Sector Undertaking/Statutory or Autonomous Organizations; (a)(i) Holding analogous posts on regular basis in parent Cadre/Department; or (ii) with two year's service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in the pay level-7 in the pay matrix or equivalent in the parent cadre/department; and; (b) M.Phil in Clinical Psychology from a recognized university institute registered with Rehabilitation Council of India Experience: Desirable: 2 years of Clinical experience in Paediatrics or developmental assessment in infants and toddlers Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the last date of receipt of applications) Other conditions: Open only to officers of Central/State Governments, Union Territories, recognized universities, research institutions, PSUs, statutory or autonomous organizations Qualifications are relaxable at the discretion of the S.S.C/Competent Authority for candidates otherwise well qualified Desirable: 2 years of Clinical experience in Paediatrics or developmental assessment in infants and toddlers

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for GMCH Chandigarh Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications not received through proper channel, without supporting documents and photographs, unsigned or incomplete will be rejected

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Pay of official appointed on deputation will be fixed as per instructions issued by the Government of India from time to time. Deputation for three (3) years, ordinarily not exceeding three years, including any immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation Initial appointment for one year, extendable annually based on work and conduct report No extension beyond the maximum limit of 03 years under any ordinary circumstances On completing 03 years, officer relieved to parent cadre; mandatory cooling-off period applies as per guidelines Post strictly temporary on deputation; no provision for permanent absorption or regularization

content_sections.text: Assessment of Curriculum Vitae and supporting documents by the Selection Committee The Curriculum Vitae supported by documents will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Curriculum Vitae Proforma (Annexure-A) with duly attested photograph, countersigned by employer with seal Up-to-date Annual Confidential Reports/APAR for the last five years Integrity Certificate signed by the Head of the Institution Vigilance Clearance Certificate Statement of major/minor penalties in last 10 years or a no penalty certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GMCH Chandigarh Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the vacancy notice and Curriculum Vitae Proforma (Annexure-A) from http://www.gmch.gov.in. Fill the CV Proforma, affix a duly attested photograph and sign it. Get the application forwarded through your department (proper channel), countersigned by the employer with seal. The forwarding department must enclose ACR/APAR, integrity, vigilance, no court case and penalty certificates. Application must reach O/o the Director, Medical Education & Research, GMCH, Block 'D', Level-II, Sector-32, Chandigarh-160030 by 18.12.2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GMCH Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 18 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GMCH Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Child Psychologist.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GMCH Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Curriculum Vitae Proforma (Annexure-A), pages 4-6 of this PDF, also on http://www.gmch.gov.in) and send it to O/o the Director, Medical Education & Research, Government Medical College & Hospital, Block 'D', Level-II, Sector-32, Chandigarh-160030, by through proper channel (forwarded by the applicant's department), to reach by 18 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the last date of receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Level-8 (Rs. 47600-151100) in the pay matrix of 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.Phil in Clinical Psychology from a recognized university institute registered with Rehabilitation Council of India; officers holding analogous posts on regular basis, or with two years' regular service in pay level-7 or equivalent.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open only to officers of Central/State Governments, Union Territories, recognized universities, research institutions, PSUs, statutory or autonomous organizations. Qualifications are relaxable at the discretion of the S.S.C/Competent Authority for candidates otherwise well qualified.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications not received through proper channel, without supporting documents and photographs, unsigned or incomplete will be rejected.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Assessment of Curriculum Vitae and supporting documents by the Selection Committee. The Curriculum Vitae supported by documents will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation for three (3) years, ordinarily not exceeding three years, including any immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation. Initial appointment for one year, extendable annually based on work and conduct report. No extension beyond the maximum limit of 03 years under any ordinary circumstances.
